summary.text: Greg Davids is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 26B, with a tenure beginning in 2013, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Davids has also served in the House in earlier periods and has owned a business and farm.

paragraphs.text: Greg Davids earned a B.S. in social science from Winona State University.
His career experience includes owning a business and farm.
Ballotpedia lists Davids as holding Minnesota House seats from 1991 to 2007 and from 2009 to 2013, before beginning his current tenure in 2013.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Commerce Finance and Policy, Ethics (as co-chair) and Taxes (as co-chair) committees.
